items.title: Louis Hayes interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I think Bobby Timmons was the original pianist, and then Barry Harris was there for a period of time, and then Victor Feldman.

ctx.x: What was it — Joe Zawinul replaced Bobby Timmons?
No, I think he replaced Victor Feldman.
And Wynton Kelly was in there somewhere too.
